body.name: Rounded branchwise Chernoff certificate
body.construction: Replace \(q\) and \(r\) in every program of \(\text{def:branch-programs}\) by the exact rounded fractions \(N_{i,T}^{(1)}/T\) and \(N_{i,T}^{(2)}(e)/T\), call the resulting values \(Q_{T,h}^{\mathrm E}\) and \(Q_{T,e,j}^{\mathrm T}\), and return \(B_T=\exp\{-TQ_{T,h}^{\mathrm E}\}+\sum_{e\ne h}\sum_{j\ne e,h}\exp\{-TQ_{T,e,j}^{\mathrm T}\}\).
